title: Deutsche Bank worried about Canadian steelmaker and its Russian owners, leaked records show
dek: The National Post reports that leaked records show Deutsche Bank was worried about a Canadian steelmaker and its Russian owners.
summary: According to the National Post's headline, leaked records show that Deutsche Bank was worried about a Canadian steelmaker and its Russian owners. The publisher's excerpt is empty. The material does not name the steelmaker or describe the nature of the bank's concerns.
keyFacts: The report is based on leaked records
whyItMatters: Russian-owned steel assets in Western markets face heightened scrutiny from banks and regulators. This could affect their access to financing.
implications: Lenders, customers and suppliers of the steelmaker may face greater compliance scrutiny. Readers should await further detail on any regulatory follow-up.
